purpose: Focused protected-mode Ghidra contract for the MAP and descriptor helpers used by player contact and platform motion.

source.pipeline: research/tools/run_player_external_closure.py using Ghidra raw NE segment import, no-analysis annotation/decompiler/listing export, and address-qualified protected-mode assembly

shared_indexing.map_base: FS loaded from DS:657C; word read at DS:657A + map_index
shared_indexing.descriptor_bank: map_word & 0x01FF is retained by AND AH,1 as the tile ID, multiplied by DS:30D4, then DS:6582 + low16(tile_id*stride + 2) is read under FS loaded from DS:6584
shared_indexing.writes: none of the five helpers writes the player record or callback globals

contracts.name: probe_map_word_bit_4000_1C6E
contracts.outputs: AX=MAP word; ZF=1 iff (MAP word & 0x4000)==0; BX/CX/DX are scratch

contracts.name: probe_map_word_bit_1000_1C92
contracts.outputs: AX=MAP word; ZF=1 iff (MAP word & 0x1000)==0; BX/CX/DX are scratch

contracts.name: probe_descriptor_quadrant_5C27
contracts.inputs: AX=Y pixels; BX=X pixels; original AX/BX low bit-3 quadrant selects the tested descriptor bit
contracts.outputs: DX=raw descriptor word; ZF=1 iff selected low-nibble bit is clear; AX/BX/CX restored; final TEST gives caller condition

contracts.name: read_descriptor_word_5CC3
contracts.outputs: DX=raw descriptor word; no caller-consumed flag contract

contracts.name: probe_map_word_bit_0800_5DC3
contracts.outputs: AX=MAP word; ZF=1 iff (MAP word & 0x0800)==0; BX/CX/DX are scratch

semantic_boundary.stopping_rule: Do not expand beyond these readers unless a parity mismatch attributes a player or platform simulation divergence to an unmodeled descriptor-table writer. Sound, renderer, and presentation consumers remain outside this closure.

independent_ghidra_check.method: run_player_external_closure.py exports two independent protected-mode Ghidra projects; focused listings include all five descriptor helpers
